"Tune O Rangeele Kaisa Jadu Kiya" is a mesmerizing romantic duet from the 1981 Bollywood film Kudrat, featuring the enchanting voice of Lata Mangeshkar. The song beautifully captures the magic of love, with the lyrics penned by Majrooh Sultanpuri and music composed by the legendary R.D. Burman.
